title: Half Gauge
text: Display input value on semicircular scale, {Label} sets Block label position; {Connection} sets the signal to connect and display signal connection, {Minimum}, {Maximum}, {Tick Interval} sets the interval between major tick marks, {Scale Colors} sets the color indications on gauge scale colors for scale, {Scale Direction} sets the gauge scale direction, {Opacity} sets the block background opacity, {Foreground Color} sets the block foreground color, {Background Color} sets the block background color and {Font Color} sets the block font color. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Connection
params.values: Signal to connect and display signal connection options

params.name: Tick Interval
params.values: Interval between major tick marks auto (default) | scalar

params.name: Scale Colors
params.values: Color indications on gauge scale colors for scale ranges

params.name: Label
params.values: Block label position Top (default) | Bottom | Hide

params.name: Foreground Color
params.values: Block foreground color [r g b] vector

params.name: Background Color
params.values: Block background color [r g b] vector

params.name: Font Color
params.values: Block font color [r g b] vector
